create_keep_all_slabs_filter: create a keep_all_slabs filter class that passes through all adsorbate slab configs unchanged
create_keep_slabs_with_miller_indices_fi: create a filter that keeps only slabs matching specified miller index tuples
create_prompt_for_slabs_to_keep_filter: create an interactive filter that prompts the user to choose which slabs to keep
use_keep_slabs_with_miller_indices: use keep_slabs_with_miller_indices to filter adslabs by allowed miller index values
use_prompt_for_slabs_to_keep_sort_key: use the prompt_for_slabs_to_keep sort key to order adslabs by millers, shift, and top
